pages.title: Absolute Notes II
pages.text: The middle absolute volume: crystallised law, a theory of everything, neutronium, the first uncountable cardinal, the E8 lattice and the Hopf fibration. It is where the most elegant structures I have found are set side by side, and it is beautiful in a way that makes me slightly afraid.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gathered the most symmetric things I had made - an E8 lattice, a Hopf fibration, aleph-one, a theory of everything and crystallised law - and bound them with neutronium. The Femtoscale line produced the volume that I now consider my best work.
